name: Khafre claim
summary: The structures announced beneath Khafre in March 2025, placed in the ground as if they were real: eight vertical shafts reaching about 640 m, and a deeper structure near 1,220 m. If they existed, would ordinary seismology see them?

sources.egyptianstreets2025: Nawar, B. (26 March 2025). Unraveling the Pyramid Mystery: Claims of an Underground City Debunked. Egyptian Streets. "eight vertical structures extending over 2,100 feet beneath the pyramids"; "additional unidentified structures potentially lying at depths of 4,000 feet".
sources.euronews2025: Economou, A. (26 March 2025). Going underground: Experts clash over 'hidden city' beneath Egypt pyramids. Euronews. "massive vertical shafts, spiral staircases ... more than 2,000 feet (610m) beneath the surface".

notes: Only the count and the depths are published, and only in press accounts of the 15 March 2025 briefing; the claim has not appeared in a peer-reviewed paper.
Diameters, layout and the size of the deeper structure are not published: they are representative choices (10 m shafts in two rows of four; an 80 m block) and marked so.
Spiral paths around the shafts are omitted: at the wavelengths that reach 640 m they are far below resolution.
